entry.title: Whatever it Takes
entry.summary:
Author: Mimister

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 4,573Chapters: 2/?Kudos: 1

Summary: Merlin waits on the shores on lake Avalon for over 1,500 years for his king to return. His patience is suffocated by sorrow and he is drowning in grief, especially as he realizes that he is about to lose his friend once again as his memory fades and he can't quite remember Arthur's face.But then the king appears on the shores - lifeless and cold, a reminder for Merlin to keep going. Still the sorcerer refuses to do so and bends heaven and earth to bring Arthur back to life.Knowing that he did something inexcusable Merlin wakes 1,500 years past, Arthur by his side, the battle of Camlann just won. The price for the king's breath? The world's magic. Now, Merlin has to fight is feelings for the king, mend their strained relationship and is met by furious druids and sorcerers that demand magic brought back. Without it the world is succumbing to a sickness affecting animals, people and the world alike. Yet, the only thing that is truly important to Merlin is that Arthur stays alive. --First inspired by "What if I miss you for the rest of my life" by Janine Berdin.
